title: Folio case study
text: Folio is a private document Q&A application. It combines keyword and semantic retrieval within the signed-in account's selected documents. A local model answers using retrieved passages with citations. The portfolio shows a real app recording using a fictional handbook, with generation waits shortened. One regression run passed 8 answer checks across 6 fictional documents. Source quality still requires human review. Do not infer enterprise adoption or production scale from this project.

title: Speedway POS case study
text: Speedway POS is a Windows offline-first checkout application built with React, Rust/Tauri 2 and SQLite. Cashiers add items, review totals, take payment and save receipts. SQLite atomic writes keep sales consistent and receipts local even offline. It supports inventory, store reporting, refunds, access rules and transaction audit history. The walkthrough is a development profile using a sample cash sale.
answer: Speedway POS is a Windows checkout application built with React, Rust/Tauri 2 and SQLite. Sales and receipts are stored locally using atomic database writes, so checkout can work offline. It includes inventory, refunds, reporting and transaction audit history. The recording shows a development profile and sample cash sale.
